description: The minimal next experiment: have an EXISTING DSH agent consume a bounded, source-qualified execution history to improve continuation or collaboration.

shape.input: one canonical Work Attempt whose durable association is ASSOCIATION_QUALIFIED
shape.readPath: the read-only attributed Preview already implemented by P2-C, bounded to a small page and carrying its coverage and durability provenance
shape.consumer: the existing principal or a delegated worker, receiving the attributed execution history as READ-ONLY background — never as authority
shape.bound: the Preview must remain inspection data: it cannot resume a session, settle Work, verify a result or promote

whatItWouldTest: whether a source-qualified execution history measurably improves continuation decisions
whether the bounded page size and coverage metadata are sufficient for the consumer to reason honestly
whether presenting execution facts as read-only background preserves the owner separation
whatItMustNotDo: let the Preview resume an Agent
turn a Session event into Work settlement or Promotion
expose a raw Session history to every model, route or peer
prerequisites: a live model turn (out of P2-C scope)
an explicit product decision on which consumer receives the history
a measurement plan that separates the history's effect from other continuation signals
